name: Standard week
description: Defaults with an empty fridge: 150 g protein a day, up to 60 min of cooking every day, no pins. The same week as the offline validation.

name: Use it up
description: Plan around last week's leftovers before they turn.

name: Busy weekdays
description: A long cook on shopping day, quick cooks on work days, and one day with no cooking at all.

name: Favourites pinned
description: Three pinned favourites and a higher protein target. May show the protein-short warning instead of a plan that hits 170 g.

name: Pin conflict
description: Shows the infeasible state on purpose: a 45-minute recipe pinned on a 20-minute day.
